merchantBlurb: Mother always said I'd grow up someday. I grew a garden instead!
idolDescription: A clay pot of brood soil torn from the Hive Mother's nest. A seed-hoarding grub may move into a room with a free bed.
concept: A larva from the Hive Mother's brood that never pupated and took up gardening: straw hat with a Glow Tulip, wicker seed basket, tin watering can on a strap; tips its hat to greet.
bossWhy: Hive Mother over Glurch: the merchant is one of her larvae (larva body/head palette), the idol uses hive-flesh and clay from her Clay Caves arena; a Glurch idol would read as another slime merchant next to the vanilla Slime Merchant.
stockNotes: Vanilla prices all these at sellValue -1 (=1 coin sell / 5 buy), too cheap for biome-gated seeds, so prices step up with roughly the biome where each seed is first found (5-15 early caves, 20-30 mid biomes, 40 Lunacorn) and stock 20 per restock. Tools/pouches priced like the other boss merchants' mid-tier items (Pet eggs 500+); Large pouch 2500 and Octarine Seeder/hoes left out so the shop does not skip crafting progression. Sell price = price/5, no resale profit.
